items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I do remember that I did sub for Harvey Boone in the Duke Ellington orchestra

ctx.x: So as I was saying before we were so

rudely interrupted by the end of the tape on the other side, it might have been, you know, a few days or it might have been a couple of weeks -- but I do remember that I did sub for Harvey Boone in the Duke Ellington orchestra, and it might have been as early as 1926.

Uh huh. Well, we're coming down now to about '30, '31, in there and you arranged -- you had been an Alto instrumentalist, a trumpet player; you had even had your own band for a little while, and now I think comes a series of movements in and out of several bands -- Fletcher Henderson, Chick Webb, back to Fletcher Henderson. Now, I wanted to ask you about your -- about the days with Fletcher Henderson.

items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: at a place called the Richmond Club, and that was also substituting for Harvey Boone [phonetic], who was ill at the time.
